observations.pairA_difference: C6D3 has a seamless left edge extending to screen edge; 9E15 has a visible dark left border/frame around the card
observations.pairB_difference: F03E has a full-width blue underline under the title; 4B8A has a limited-width blue underline
observations.content_lost: No content lost in either pair - same text, buttons, and elements present in both versions

why.pairA: C6D3's seamless left edge and integrated positioning make it feel like part of the screen's top edge surface. The 9E15 card has a distinct border frame that reads as a separate floating dialog.
why.pairB: F03E's full-width blue underline anchors the title strongly to the top edge and creates visual continuity. The 4B8A limited underline reads more like a separate window panel.
